gloss: session; term (of a legislature or conference)

definitions.gloss: session; term; period of a meeting
definitions.explanation: The set period during which a legislative body, assembly, conference, or exhibition is in session. Defines when business can be conducted.

examples.japanese: {会期|かいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会期|かいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧だ。
examples.english: The Diet's session runs until next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{会期|かいき}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧せず、{廃案|はいあん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The bill did not pass during the session and was scrapped.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (assembly, meeting) + {期|き} (period). Most often used of the Diet, local assemblies, and conferences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会期|かいき}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during the session
- {会期|かいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend the session
- {会期|かいき}{末|まつ}: the end of the session

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧: term of office — the period a person holds a position, not a meeting
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: period — the general word for any span of time
